t: Malaysia was formed on 16 September 1963 from Malaya, Singapore, Sabah and Sarawak; Singapore left in 1965.
Its king is elected every five years from nine hereditary Malay rulers, a system unique in the world.
The New Economic Policy after the 1969 riots reshaped wealth between ethnic groups as the economy industrialised rapidly.
dyk: Malaysia's head of state, the Yang di-Pertuan Agong, is chosen by secret ballot of the nine hereditary Malay rulers, who have largely followed a fixed rotation since 1957.
ev: Malaysia is proclaimed on 16 September; Indonesia steps up its Confrontation
Singapore is separated from the federation on 9 August
Racial riots of 13 May lead to emergency rule and the New Economic Policy
Mahathir Mohamad becomes prime minister, serving until 2003
Capital controls and the dismissal of Anwar Ibrahim spark the Reformasi movement
The Barisan Nasional loses power for the first time since independence
Anwar Ibrahim becomes prime minister of a unity government

f.capital: Kuala Lumpur (administrative centre at Putrajaya from 1999)
f.predecessor: Federation of Malaya; Crown Colonies of Singapore, North Borneo and Sarawak
